description: Objects with different attribute names and unrelated attribute types don't unify
notes: The spec unifies two object types to an object type with the union of their attributes, so this should give {a = 1, b = null}. hashicorp/hcl tries to unify objects with different attribute names to a map, and a number and a tuple have no common element type (unifyObjectTypesToMap in cty/convert/unify.go).
